title: Marketing site: a features list kept current with Papyrus releases
description:
The Papyrus marketing site (AnthusAI/Papyrus-web, private; content/index.md, about 500 words) is a high-level pitch with no feature list, so recent capabilities are undocumented there. Add a Features section or page in the site's newsprint style, keep it current, and make 'document it on the marketing site' a standing task in every feature epic.

Audit to start from (features shipped or nearly shipped, none listed today):
- Editorial policy, mission, sections and editorial checks as backend data, edited in newsroom Administration (4.0.0).
- Static publishing by S3 projection: pages rendered on publish, targeted CDN invalidation, merge-is-deploy with post-deploy render, monthly archives (pilot).
- Per-site backend in the customer's own AWS account; Google sign-in; editors and admins.
- Newsroom with Kanbus editorial themes and per-publication theming.
- Story reporting trail: versions, consulted and cited references, messages.
- Agent collaboration: operator CLI over AWS signing; agent curation delegation by device approval (labels recorded as the person's, with their quoted instruction).
- Cyclotron classification per section; labeled accept/reject references as training signal.
- Monitoring (Hacker News collector today; general monitors in progress).
- Upload-time image renditions.
- Coming: standard Markus front end, content shapes (PPY-cf5e4c), public site forms (PPY-caf9be), newsletters (PPY-31455f), data features (charts fed by backend data).
Verify each against the current release before publishing; mark coming features as coming.
